☀️ Your money this morning, Friday 13 November

🇺🇸 Overnight in New York: US shares slipped as interest-rate worries grew. The S&P 500 fell 0.4% after winning back most of an early 0.8% drop. The Nasdaq and the Dow also fell 0.4%.

🇿🇦 The JSE Top 40 closed 0.6% lower on Thursday.

🛢️ Brent oil is about $95.72 a barrel this morning, around 2% higher than yesterday afternoon. Gold is up 0.9% at about $3,910, and the rand is steady at about R16.76 to the dollar.

What it means for you: dearer oil makes a December petrol price cut less likely.

Prices are 15-minute delayed (06:52). Education, not financial advice.
